utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — see you tomorrow afternoon at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll swing by the repair drive later, check what they still need, and pass along any updates.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll be there tomorrow afternoon with the wrench set and replacement hose.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep everyone posted, and the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll plan around the school run and come by after if that’s easiest.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect, Faye — come by whenever works best after the school run, and I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I can bring the small toolbox and some spare screws, and I’ll check the shed for any usable wood too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great, Oren — thanks for pitching in. Let me know if you need anything else from me for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — I’ll let you know if I need anything. I’ll check the shed and bring what I can for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — I’m just coordinating who’s handling what, so if you can grab any tools or supplies we’re short on, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can do that — I’ll check what tools and supplies we’re short on and let you know. Thanks for keeping it organized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Noah — thanks. Just send me the list of anything we’re missing, and I’ll help make sure we get it covered.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check the list and see what tools or supplies we’re still missing, then I’ll follow up so we can fill any gaps before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll swing by the repair drive while I’m out and let you know what they say.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. I’ll compare it with the list and circle back if anything’s still missing before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word to a few more neighbors and see who can donate or volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn — that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and send anyone interested your way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m still set for tomorrow afternoon, and I’ll start with the front gate first. Point me to the tools when I arrive, and I’ll get to the shelves after that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll have the tools ready and I’ll let you know right away if anything else is still missing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll come by tomorrow afternoon and get started on the front gate. If you spot any other missing tools, just let me know and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re still collecting donations and volunteers, and it’s going pretty well so far.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s helpful, thanks — I’m still catching up, so if you hear what they need most, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Please check with a couple people first, and if they’re okay with it, the community center lot sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Mina — I’ll check with a couple people first, and if they’re okay with it, we can use the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — let me know what they say.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana — I’ll wait for your update and plan accordingly.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the tools and supplies first, then I’ll let you know exactly what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana — that works for me. I’ll hold off until I hear back from you and plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll keep checking on the drop-off spot and bring the gloves and tape measure.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Rey — I’ve got the gloves and tape measure noted, and thanks for checking the drop-off spot too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye on the drop-off spot and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s still at the community center parking lot on Maple Street, right by the library entrance. If you’re coming tomorrow afternoon, Oak Avenue is the easiest way in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for tomorrow afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — it’s still set for tomorrow afternoon at the community center parking lot on Maple Street, right by the library entrance. Use Oak Avenue for the easiest access.
